item.title: Nigeria’s inflation rate now 15% — first increase in eight months
item.description: The National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) says Nigeria’s headline inflation rate rose to 15.15 percent in December 2025. item.title: Badenoch sacks Robert Jenrick over defection plot, appoints Nick Timothy as shadow justice secretary
item.description: Kemi Badenoch, leader of the UK Conservative Party, has appointed Nick Timothy as the new shadow justice secretary following the dismissal of Robert Jenrick over an alleged plot to defect from the party. Badenoch announced Timothy’s appointment on Thursday, hours after sacking Jenrick from the shadow cabinet, removing the party whip, and suspending his Conservative Party membership. item.title: Nigeria most dangerous country to be doctor – Aisha Yesufu
item.description: Human rights activist, Aisha Yesufu, has lamented that Nigeria is the most dangerous country for doctors to live and practise their profession. The co-convener of BringBackOurGirls Movement made this known in a statement posted on her official X handle on Thursday. She was reacting to the abduction of a medical doctor and his brother in Edo State early in January this year. item.title: FULL DRAW: Falcons get tricky group ahead of WAFCON title defence
item.description: The Super Falcons of Nigeria have been drawn alongside Zambia, Egypt and Malawi in the group stage of the CAF Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON) 2026. The draw was conducted at the Mohammed VI Football Complex in Rabat, Morocco, the host nation, on Thursday. The Super Falcons will begin their WAFCON title defence in Group C and face Zambia, a team Nigeria thrashed 5-0 enroute to triumph in Morocco last year. item.title: Atiku’s son joins APC, backs Tinubu’s re-election in 2027
item.description: Abubakar, son of former Vice President and 2023 Peoples Democratic Party presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar, has defected from the Peoples Democratic Party to the ruling All Progressives Congress, pledging to work for the re-election of President Bola Tinubu in 2027.The defection, announced on Thursday at the National Assembly, Abuja, is being viewed within political circles as a symbolic and strategic blow to Atiku’s presidential ambition and a major boost to the APC’s consolidation efforts
